IX <cite ref="A01314"><he>אַיֶּלֶת</he></cite>).—<he>יַעֲלַת חן</he> ‘graceful gazelle’, an expression used in praise of a bride and also of a scholar on his ordination (v., however, <cite ref="P00772"><he>עָלָה</he></cite>).
